_note: Data for AirPlay FairPlay v3 (screen mirroring) receiver key recovery, revision 2. Apple-derived constants. decrypt_message reduces to the AES-128 inverse cipher with explicit round keys (decryptMessage.round_keys); the final key step reduces to single-key AES-128 (final_aes). The white-box tables of the final key step are not needed and are omitted. All values hex. See 04-fairplay.md.

round_keys.desc: NORMATIVE. decrypt_message round keys, per mode: 176 bytes = 11 x 16, round key r at bytes [16r, 16r+16). Used with the standard AES-128 inverse cipher (see 04-fairplay.md section 4.6). Round keys 0 and 10 are identical for all modes; rounds 1..9 differ per mode and are not an AES key schedule.

message_iv.desc: NORMATIVE. CBC IV per mode, 4 x 16 bytes.

table_s2.desc: SUPERSEDED (revision 1 table-driven form, appendix A; same output as round_keys). 144 S-boxes of 256 bytes each, flat; table i = s2[256*i:256*i+256]. Indexed s2[(97*i)%144] where i=base+p.

table_s9.desc: SUPERSEDED (revision 1 table-driven form, appendix A; same output as round_keys). 1024 uint32 (little-endian in this blob) = 4 InvMixColumns T-boxes of 256 words. table_s9[256*t + x]. NOT plain InvMixColumns: affine, see appendix A for its exact structure.

table_s10.desc: SUPERSEDED (revision 1 table-driven form, appendix A; same output as round_keys). 16 S-boxes of 256 bytes, flat; final-round table = s10[256*p:256*p+256], p=0..15.

message_key.desc: SUPERSEDED (revision 1 table-driven form, appendix A; same output as round_keys). message_key[mode][0..143], 4 modes x 144 bytes.

i0_index.desc: 11 indices used for the buffer3 combine (byte offset = i0_index[i]*4)

default_sap_tail.desc: oldSap[0x80:0x100] (128 bytes) used as the receiver SAP in newSap

delta0.desc: 16-byte residual XORed into the AES-128 decrypt output (04-fairplay.md section 4.4)

key_xor.desc: the AES-128 key is sessionKey XOR this constant (0x79 repeated 16x)
